messages:
Maya Chen: :wave: Hey folks — first week here. Trying to run a short GPU test in eu-west1 but gcloud keeps returning 403. Okta SSO signs me in. Who should I ping for project/billing link and a quota bump for T4s? Also need read-only access to AWS prod for metrics. Thanks!

Raj Patel: Welcome, Maya! @Maya can you paste the output of `gcloud auth list` and the project id? I can check IAM and billing links. Also drop your Okta email so I can trace SSO mapping.

Maya Chen: Sure — Okta email is maya@redwood.ai. `gcloud auth list` shows:
```
* account: maya@redwood.ai (active)
```
Project id: redwood-eu-dev-2

Raj Patel: OK. Looks like redwood-eu-dev-2 isn't linked to our EU billing account so requests fail. @Asha can you confirm? I'll open a billing ticket and request eu-west1 T4 quota bump to 8.

Asha Rivera: Adding context — I can see the project under the org but billingAccount is null. I'll run the billing link flow. Raj, include billing account id 01A2B3-C456D in the ticket. Expect ~1 business day for quota approval unless we escalate.

Raj Patel: Filed INC-2026-8421 to Billing: "Link redwood-eu-dev-2 to billing 01A2B3-C456D and request T4 quota to 8 in eu-west1." Also kicking off an AWS role request for Maya.

dev-onboard-bot: Provision task started for maya@redwood.ai — creating AWS read-only role. Estimated completion: 30 minutes. Role ARN: arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/Redwood_ReadOnly

Morgan Lee: Maya — once the role is ready, you can assume it with:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/Redwood_ReadOnly --role-session-name maya-onboard
```
Then export the creds from the returned JSON. For GCP, after billing is linked run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-dev-2` to confirm your viewer role.

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks. Any ETA on the AWS role? Also is there a short checklist for connecting the eu-west1 region to the local test runner (VPC/firewall stuff)?

Raj Patel: Role ETA ~25 min. Docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/onboarding/cloud-access (ping eng-docs if 404). For the test runner you'll likely need the eu-devs VPC egress rule and service account key (we prefer workload identity), Asha will add you to the group.

Asha Rivera: I added Maya to group `eu-devs` and granted iam.viewer on redwood-eu-dev-2. Billing link completed. Quota request submitted — Billing gave it 'in progress'. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Perfect — I'll try the commands once the AWS role finishes and report back here. Appreciate the quick help! :wave:
